rows.verbatim_accepted_row: | Turn 1, owner | 36-60 | Draws Elegant Cape. Poké Ball finds Alolan Vulpix, 60 HP, which is benched. Misty gives one heads then tails and supplies one Water Energy to Lapras. No attack. | overview/sheet_02.jpg; native/t0056.00.jpg |
| Turn 2, opponent | 60-88 | Attaches one Grass Energy to Ogerpon, benches Sprigatito, 60 HP, and uses Professor's Research. No damage or points. | overview/sheets 02-03 |

| Turn 3, owner | 88-114 | Draws Lucky Ice Pop, uses Professor's Research, evolves Vulpix into Alolan Ninetales ex, 150 HP, and attaches Elegant Cape, raising its maximum/current HP to 180. Normal Water attachment brings Lapras to two Energy. No attack. Copycat and Mega Sharpedo ex remain visible in hand. | overview/sheet_03.jpg; native/t0100.00.jpg; overview/sheet_04.jpg |

| Turn 4, opponent | 114-172 | Rare Candy evolves benched Sprigatito directly into Meowscarada ex, 160 HP. Ogerpon leaves Active; its earlier Grass Energy is no longer attached. Meowscarada becomes Active with one Grass Energy. Copycat at about 148.5s refills the opponent hand. Leaf Cape raises Meowscarada to 190 HP. Flower Trick chooses the owner's Active Spot, marking the spot occupied by Lapras for 70 delayed damage at the end of the owner's next turn. | native/t0132.00.jpg; native/t0147.50.jpg; dense_144_174/sheets 01-04; native/t0165.50.jpg; native/t0170.50.jpg |

| Turn 5, owner | 172-199 | Poké Ball finds Carvanha, 50 HP, and it is benched. Normal attachment brings Lapras to three Water Energy. Surf deals 70, lowering Meowscarada 190 to 120. At turn end Flower Trick resolves on the chosen Active Spot, lowering Lapras 110 to 40. Owner passes the unused-Supporter warning. | overview/sheet_06.jpg; native/t0188.00.jpg; native/t0194.00.jpg; native/t0197.00.jpg |

| Turn 6, opponent | 199-222 | Attaches the second Grass Energy to Meowscarada. Solar Beam deals 80 to Lapras at 40 HP and knocks it out. Opponent earns one point; Lapras and its three Water Energy enter discard. Owner promotes Carvanha. | native/t0200.00.jpg; native/t0210.00.jpg; native/t0218.00.jpg; overview/sheet_07.jpg |

| Turn 7, owner | 222-248 | Draws Misty, evolves Active Carvanha into Mega Sharpedo ex, 190 HP, and attaches one Water Energy. Uses Copycat, shuffling the remaining hand and drawing Irida, another Alolan Ninetales ex, and Cyrus. Turbo Shark deals 70, lowering Meowscarada 120 to 50, and supplies one Water Energy to benched Ninetales. Sharpedo still has its original one Water Energy. | native/t0228.00.jpg; native/t0236.00.jpg; native/t0242.00.jpg; native/t0246.00.jpg |

| Turn 8, opponent | 248-289 | Copycat at 256.5s refreshes the hand. Plays Fragrant Forest at about 266.5s and activates it at 270.5s. A second Sprigatito is benched at 276.5s. Attaches Grass Energy to benched Ogerpon, restoring it to one Energy. Solar Beam deals 80, lowering Sharpedo 190 to 110. | dense_248_288/sheets 01-05; native/t0256.50.jpg; native/t0270.50.jpg; native/t0287.50.jpg |

| Turn 9, owner | 289-345 | Draws Lucky Ice Pop. Plays it three times, healing Sharpedo 110 to 130 to 150 to 170. First two flips are heads and return the card; third is tails and it enters discard. Normal attachment supplies Ninetales' second Water Energy. Sharpedo pivots to the Bench while retaining its one Water Energy, and Ninetales becomes Active at 180 HP. Binding Snow, printed 80, knocks out the 50-HP Meowscarada. Owner earns two points. Ogerpon, 130 HP and one Grass Energy, is promoted. | native/t0299.50.jpg; native/t0312.00.jpg; native/t0316.00.jpg; native/t0317.50.jpg; native/t0320.00.jpg; native/t0323.00.jpg; native/t0330.00.jpg; native/t0338.00.jpg; overview/sheet_10.jpg |

| Turn 10, opponent | 345-355 | Binding Snow blocks Energy Zone attachment to the Active. Opponent attaches one Grass Energy to benched Sprigatito and passes without attacking. Ogerpon remains at one Energy, below its two-Grass attack cost. | overview/sheet_10.jpg; native/t0357.00.jpg |

| Turn 11, owner | 355-373 | Draws Misty. It stays in hand and is not played. No normal attachment is observed; the available Energy remains in the zone. Binding Snow deals 80, reducing Ogerpon 130 to 50, and again blocks Active Energy Zone attachment for the following turn. Ninetales remains 180 HP. | native/t0359.00.jpg; native/t0360.00.jpg; native/t0364.00.jpg; native/t0366.00.jpg; overview/sheet_11.jpg |

| Turn 12, opponent | 373-405 | Active attachment remains blocked. A second Grass Energy goes to benched Sprigatito. Leaf Cape raises Sprigatito 60 to 90 HP. Ogerpon retreats to the Bench, discarding its one Grass Energy, and Sprigatito becomes Active with two Grass Energy. No attack or point change is shown before the owner's next turn. | overview/sheets 11-12; native/t0396.00.jpg; native/t0398.00.jpg; native/t0401.00.jpg; native/t0404.00.jpg |

| Turn 13, owner and concession | 405-420 | Draws another Mega Sharpedo ex. Plays Cyrus, choosing damaged benched Ogerpon, 50 HP, and bringing it Active at about 416s. Opponent concedes before another attack resolves. Owner has two earned points versus one, Active Ninetales at 180 HP with two Water, and benched Sharpedo at 170 HP with one Water. | native/t0410.00.jpg; native/t0414.00.jpg; native/t0416.00.jpg; native/t0418.00.jpg |
